buildEnvironment.note: Cross-compiled from Linux using rustup target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu, gcc-mingw-w64 (x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc 13, win32 threading), and nsis 3.09 (Ubuntu noble/universe apt packages). Tauri's own CLI printed: 'Cross-platform compilation is experimental and does not support all features. Please use a matching host system for full compatibility.' - that warning is reproduced here verbatim and is not overridden by anything in this manifest.

signingNote: No code-signing certificate is available in this environment. Tauri's own build output stated: 'Signing, by default, is only supported on Windows hosts... for now, skipping signing the installer.' This is NOT a Microsoft-trusted or Authenticode-signed release. A real Windows installation will show an 'Unknown Publisher' SmartScreen warning; this is expected and must not be represented as a defect or hidden from the operator.
